answer: Require each agent to register a nullifier derived from one non-transferable credential, published in a registry verifiable in seconds. A second registration from the same credential yields the same nullifier and is rejected, so an attacker cannot wander between accounts hiding duplicates. Each registration locks 200 tokens for 60 days, slashed 100% on a duplicate. Crossing the three-identity ridge per funder freezes all three pending audit. A grove of auditor nodes mirrors the registry. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 200,000 tokens plus 1,000 credentials, with no bulk discount.
